model.strictDominance: A dominates B only when A is no worse on every comparable selection-active dimension and strictly better on at least one; unknown, conflicted, missing, not-applicable, and non-comparable evidence creates no advantage.

outcomes.meaning: The singleton input candidate, or the sole non-dominated candidate, is selected by governed rules.
outcomes.downstreamPermission: Expose exact identity and structured comparison provenance for a later separately governed presentation boundary.
outcomes.downstreamProhibition: Does not authorize DECISION_READY, Decision Authorization, Decision Card, recommendation prose, or commerce.

outcomes.meaning: Multiple candidates have equal known comparison profiles on all active dimensions.
outcomes.downstreamPermission: Expose the exact unordered tied set and reasons.

outcomes.meaning: Different active dimensions favor different candidates or evidence is indeterminate, leaving multiple non-dominated candidates.
outcomes.downstreamPermission: Expose the exact unordered non-dominated set, trade-offs, and uncertainty.
outcomes.downstreamProhibition: No aggregation, weights, or winner inference.

outcomes.meaning: No accepted selection-active preference exists for a multi-candidate pool.
outcomes.downstreamPermission: Preserve and expose the exact unordered input pool.

outcomes.meaning: Authority, provenance, contract, or evidence integrity failed.
outcomes.downstreamPermission: Expose only the failure reason and safe provenance.
outcomes.downstreamProhibition: No selection, comparison result, recommendation, or commerce.

evidenceStates.UNKNOWN: No advantage; preserve indeterminate comparison and disclose when material.
evidenceStates.MISSING: No advantage; absence is not negative evidence and material absence is disclosed.
evidenceStates.CONFLICTED: No advantage; do not resolve by LLM, preserve indeterminate comparison and disclose conflict.
evidenceStates.NOT_APPLICABLE: Exclude that dimension for that candidate pair; never coerce to a value.
evidenceStates.NON_COMPARABLE: No advantage; incompatible unit, regime, program basis, market, or evidence status makes the pair indeterminate and requires disclosure.

failClosedRules: incompatible units or test standards used as comparable

rules.rationaleRef: matching catalog rationale binding for REMOTE_CONTROL when present; otherwise evidence refs only

scenarios.outcome: SELECTED_SINGLE without comparative ranking; preserve disclosures.

scenarios.outcome: PRESENT may dominate NOT_AVAILABLE; UNKNOWN remains indeterminate.

scenarios.outcome: PRESENT may dominate NOT_AVAILABLE; UNKNOWN remains indeterminate.

scenarios.name: Low noise IMPORTANT with unknown or non-comparable evidence
scenarios.outcome: No invented advantage; NON_DOMINATED_SET or TIED_TOP_SET with disclosure.

scenarios.name: Two preferences favor different candidates
scenarios.outcome: NON_DOMINATED_SET; no aggregation or implicit priority.

scenarios.name: Known budget-compatible pool plus preserved unknown-price candidates
scenarios.outcome: Compare only supplied known-compatible pool on non-price active dimensions; preserve unknown-price set unranked and disclose.

scenarios.name: Conflicted technical evidence
scenarios.outcome: No advantage, no LLM resolution; indeterminate result and conflict disclosure.

scenarios.name: Candidate input order reversed
scenarios.outcome: Same semantic outcome and deterministic fingerprint after canonical serialization.

scenarios.name: Catalog rationale counts differ
scenarios.outcome: Same selection result; rationale count has no effect.

scenarios.name: Persona differs
scenarios.outcome: Same selection result; persona effect NONE.

scenarios.name: Policy or input provenance mismatch
scenarios.outcome: FAILED_CLOSED distinct from tie or no governed selection.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: No frozen selection model; comparison policy only defines comparability.
productDecisionRegister.runtimeConsequence: May yield one, tied, non-dominated, or no governed selection.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: Question policy supplies explicit normalized answers for three discriminating needs.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: Activate only REMOTE_CONTROL=WANTED, DETERGENT_CONVENIENCE=WANTED, and LOW_NOISE_PRIORITY=IMPORTANT.
productDecisionRegister.runtimeConsequence: Only enumerated accepted context can influence selection.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: No authority assigns priority among accepted soft preferences.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: All active preferences are equal-priority; no weights.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: Semantic mapping names SPIN_NOISE_DB and comparison policy requires comparable regimes.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: Only lower comparable SPIN_NOISE_DB is advantageous for LOW_NOISE_PRIORITY=IMPORTANT; no other numeric fact is active.
productDecisionRegister.runtimeConsequence: Prevents assumed directions and regime mixing.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: Need-evidence mappings bind REMOTE_CONTROL to SMART_CONNECTIVITY and DETERGENT_CONVENIENCE to AUTO_DOSING.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: Exact PRESENT advantages exact NOT_AVAILABLE only when WANTED; UNKNOWN has no advantage.
productDecisionRegister.runtimeConsequence: Capabilities affect only matching active needs.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: Sufficiency owns hard budget and preserves unknown-price candidates; price is volatile commerce data.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: Price is disclosure-only after eligibility; lower price is not authorized as preference.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: Frozen comparison policy says UNKNOWN is neither false nor worse.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: Unknown creates no advantage and makes the pair indeterminate on that dimension with disclosure.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: Comparison policy requires non-conflicted current fact.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: Conflicted evidence creates no advantage, is disclosed, and is never resolved by LLM.
productDecisionRegister.runtimeConsequence: Pair remains indeterminate on affected dimension.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: No frozen tie authority exists; canonical ordering is serialization only.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: Represent equal top profiles as TIED_TOP_SET with no tie-break.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: Sufficiency permits singleton and multiple pools but supplies no winner.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: A single winner is not required; singleton or sole non-dominated candidate may produce SELECTED_SINGLE.
Return exact unordered set with structured trade-offs and deterministic canonical serialization.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: Active Question Policy has no tie-resolution question or explicit preference priority answer.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: Do not re-enter Planner unless a separate tie-resolution question policy is approved.
productDecisionRegister.runtimeConsequence: Current outcomes stop at tied/non-dominated set.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: Catalog rationaleBindings bind evidence, needs, disclosures, and limitations but contain no normative ordering.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: Rationale explains governed advantages after selection; count and richness have no effect.
productDecisionRegister.runtimeConsequence: Reasons retain evidence provenance without creating result.

productDecisionRegister.currentAuthorityEvidence: Appliances persona is DERIVED_PLANNING with directCandidateEffect and decisionUse NONE; sufficiency persona effects are NONE.
productDecisionRegister.proposedDecision: Persona selectionEffect and rankingEffect remain NONE.
